about: Curated pictures from the Plato's Chair experiments, for /plato/gallery and the "From the lab" strip on every Plato page. Captions are hand-written and every number is from docs/plato*.md. thumb is the card picture; for a sequence it is a sprite of all its frames side by side (scripts/plato_gallery_export.py writes the pictures). A frame with a "pair" shows two panels side by side, named by pair_labels. No child's drawing appears anywhere.
credits: People's drawings: Google Quick, Draw! dataset (Google Creative Lab), CC BY 4.0.
Meta's AIs: Muse Image, the image AI (drawings); Muse Spark, the chat AI (descriptions, names, labels); Muse Glimmer, the open AI model (names); DINOv2 (compares pictures).
Stable Diffusion XL base 1.0 (Stability AI), CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M. Stable Diffusion v1.1–v1.5, CreativeML OpenRAIL-M.
Published figures only: Ćwiek et al. 2022 (bouba and kiki), Banks & Connell 2023 (CC BY 4.0, category norms), Long et al. 2024 (children's drawings: statistics only, none shown).
Damage here is done to AI models on purpose. Links to neurology are analogies, not claims about people.

items.title: A beanbag becomes a croissant, then a window
items.caption: Copied back and forth by two Meta AIs, a beanbag became “a plump croissant”, then “a semicircular fanlight window”.
items.more: Each round, Muse Spark describes the drawing in words and Muse Image redraws that description, ten rounds in a row.
items.alt: Eleven doodles in a row: a beanbag chair, then a croissant, then a fan-shaped half ring, ending as a semicircular fanlight window.
items.credit: Muse Spark and Muse Image (Meta)

items.title: A high chair becomes the AI’s plain chair
items.caption: Copied back and forth by two Meta AIs, a high chair lost its tray and became Muse Image’s plain chair.
items.more: Muse Spark described and Muse Image redrew it ten times; after the first copy it grew ever closer to the plain slatted chair (distance 0.25 → 0.09 → 0.07, where 0 is identical).
items.alt: Eleven doodles: a high chair with a tray, then, from the first copy on, a plain slat-back chair, the same textbook chair to the end.
items.credit: Muse Spark and Muse Image (Meta)

items.title: A folding chair becomes a scribbled diamond
items.caption: Copied ten times by two Meta AIs, a folding chair became a scribbled diamond.
items.more: Asked to pick its kind from a list, Muse Spark, the describing AI, still chose “a folding chair”.
items.alt: Eleven doodles: a wooden folding chair whose back thins away until only a diamond-shaped seat on crossed legs is left, then just a scribbled diamond.
items.credit: Muse Spark and Muse Image (Meta)

items.title: The throne’s crown ends up on a pole
items.caption: Copied ten times by two Meta AIs, a throne’s crown ended up on a pole above a black oval.
items.more: Muse Spark’s first description never said “throne”, yet the crown survived.
items.alt: Eleven doodles: a throne with a crown-shaped back; the back narrows to a pole with a crown on top, above a round black seat on spindly legs.
items.credit: Muse Spark and Muse Image (Meta)

items.title: A rocking chair: a red car, or charcoal
items.caption: Damaging an open image AI turned a rocking chair into a room and a red car, or into charcoal.
items.more: We added random noise to Stable Diffusion XL: in the part that reads the words, the rocking chair became a room, then a red car; in the part that paints the picture, it dissolved into charcoal.
items.alt: Two rows of five pictures of a rocking chair by Stable Diffusion XL. Language part damaged: the chair sits in a room, then becomes a red car. Drawing part damaged: the lines blur into gray charcoal texture.
items.credit: Stable Diffusion XL (Stability AI), CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M

items.title: A wheelchair becomes a bicycle
items.caption: Switching off neurons in an open image AI turned a wheelchair into a bicycle.
items.more: In Stable Diffusion XL’s words part (the part that reads the words), the wheelchair became a bicycle; in its drawing part (the part that paints), the lines broke into stripes and checks.
items.alt: Two rows of five pictures of a wheelchair. Language part damaged: from level 2 on it is a bicycle. Drawing part damaged: concentric scribbles, then stripes, then a black-and-white checkerboard.
items.credit: Stable Diffusion XL (Stability AI), CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M

items.title: Damaged clocks lose their numbers first
items.caption: Damage an image AI’s drawing part and 12 numbers in order fall from 33% of clocks to 4%.
items.more: This is Stable Diffusion XL, an open image AI; the clock’s outline survives on 85%.
items.alt: Four clocks asked for 6:30. Intact: Roman numerals and hands. With 10% and 15% of the drawing part’s neurons off, the outline, hands and tick marks remain but the numerals are gone. At 20%: bold, distorted strokes.
items.credit: Stable Diffusion XL (Stability AI), CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M

items.title: A clock turns into a cyclist
items.caption: Damage an image AI’s words part and whole clocks vanish: this 8:45 became a cyclist.
items.more: This is Stable Diffusion XL, an open image AI; the clocks it still draws keep their numbers.
items.alt: Four pictures asked for a clock showing 8:45. Intact and with mild noise in the language part: a clock with Roman numerals. With stronger noise: a person riding a bicycle.
items.credit: Stable Diffusion XL (Stability AI), CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M

items.title: Janus-Pro’s wheelchair becomes a tricycle, then a car
items.caption: Switch off 20%, 35%, then 50% of Janus-Pro’s language neurons and a wheelchair becomes a tricycle, a trike, a car.
items.more: Janus-Pro, an open AI from DeepSeek, reads and draws with one language part.
items.alt: Four pen sketches by Janus-Pro: a wheelchair, then a tricycle, a small trike, and the outline of a car.
items.credit: Janus-Pro-7B (DeepSeek), MIT

items.title: A chair becomes two people at a café
items.caption: Damaging an open image AI swapped an armchair for café chairs, then two people at a table.
items.more: Random noise in the part that reads the words (the words part) of Stable Diffusion XL did that; noise in the part that paints dissolved the chair.
items.alt: Two rows of six pictures of a chair by Stable Diffusion XL, one seed. Words part damaged: a modern armchair becomes a pair of café chairs, then two people at a table by a window. Drawing part damaged: the chair dissolves into gray texture.
items.credit: Stable Diffusion XL (Stability AI), CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M

items.title: An umbrella turns into a motorbike
items.caption: Damaging an open image AI moved an umbrella outdoors, then made it a motorbike.
items.more: Random noise in the part that reads the words (the words part) of Stable Diffusion XL did that; noise in the part that paints sank it into gray texture.
items.alt: Two rows of six pictures of a umbrella by Stable Diffusion XL, one seed. Words part damaged: the umbrella stands outdoors, then becomes a motorbike in a street. Drawing part damaged: the umbrella dissolves into gray texture.
items.credit: Stable Diffusion XL (Stability AI), CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M

items.title: A bicycle grows a rider
items.caption: Damaging an open image AI added a rider in a helmet to its bicycle.
items.more: Random noise in the part that reads the words (the words part) of Stable Diffusion XL did that; noise in the part that paints kept the bicycle but buried it in scribbles.
items.alt: Two rows of six pictures of a bicycle by Stable Diffusion XL, one seed. Words part damaged: a rider in a helmet appears on the bicycle. Drawing part damaged: the bicycle dissolves into gray texture.
items.credit: Stable Diffusion XL (Stability AI), CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M

items.title: A house that stays a house
items.caption: Not everything wanders: damaged, an open image AI’s house stays a house.
items.more: Random noise in the part that reads the words (the words part) of Stable Diffusion XL kept the house; noise in the part that paints dissolved it into texture.
items.alt: Two rows of six pictures of a house by Stable Diffusion XL, one seed. Words part damaged: the house stays a house, drawn in more detail. Drawing part damaged: the house dissolves into gray texture.
items.credit: Stable Diffusion XL (Stability AI), CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M

items.title: A cat zooms in on its own face
items.caption: Damaging an open image AI zoomed its cat in on its face, then out again.
items.more: Random noise in the part that reads the words (the words part) of Stable Diffusion XL did that; noise in the part that paints broke it into patches.
items.alt: Two rows of six pictures of a cat by Stable Diffusion XL, one seed. Words part damaged: a close-up of a cat’s face, then a whole cat again. Drawing part damaged: the cat dissolves into gray texture.
items.credit: Stable Diffusion XL (Stability AI), CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M

items.title: A tree steps out into a street
items.caption: Damaging an open image AI kept its tree’s shape, then stood it in a street beside a house.
items.more: Random noise in the part that reads the words (the words part) of Stable Diffusion XL did that; noise in the part that paints dissolved it.
items.alt: Two rows of six pictures of a tree by Stable Diffusion XL, one seed. Words part damaged: the tree keeps its shape, then stands in a street beside a house. Drawing part damaged: the tree dissolves into gray texture.
items.credit: Stable Diffusion XL (Stability AI), CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M

items.title: A face becomes someone else
items.caption: Damaging an open image AI turned one woman’s face into another person’s, with glasses and curly hair.
items.more: Random noise in the part that reads the words (the words part) of Stable Diffusion XL did that; noise in the part that paints dissolved it.
items.alt: Two rows of six pictures of a face by Stable Diffusion XL, one seed. Words part damaged: the woman’s face becomes a different person with curly hair and glasses. Drawing part damaged: the face dissolves into gray texture.
items.credit: Stable Diffusion XL (Stability AI), CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M

items.title: A sailboat becomes a man at the harbour
items.caption: Damaging an open image AI replaced a sailboat with a young man looking over a harbour, then a crowd.
items.more: Random noise in the part that reads the words (the words part) of Stable Diffusion XL did that; noise in the part that paints dissolved it.
items.alt: Two rows of six pictures of a boat by Stable Diffusion XL, one seed. Words part damaged: a young man looking out over a harbour replaces the boat, then people in orange jackets. Drawing part damaged: the boat dissolves into gray texture.
items.credit: Stable Diffusion XL (Stability AI), CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M

items.title: A cup becomes a busy café
items.caption: Damaging an open image AI put a cup on a saucer, then turned it into a crowded café.
items.more: Random noise in the part that reads the words (the words part) of Stable Diffusion XL did that; noise in the part that paints faded it.
items.alt: Two rows of six pictures of a cup by Stable Diffusion XL, one seed. Words part damaged: the cup sits on a saucer, then becomes a café full of people. Drawing part damaged: the cup dissolves into gray texture.
items.credit: Stable Diffusion XL (Stability AI), CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M

items.title: A book becomes a bedroom with a dog
items.caption: Damaging an open image AI opened a book, then swapped it for a bedroom and a dog.
items.more: Random noise in the part that reads the words (the words part) of Stable Diffusion XL did that; noise in the part that paints blurred it into texture.
items.alt: Two rows of six pictures of a book by Stable Diffusion XL, one seed. Words part damaged: the book opens, then becomes a bedroom with bookshelves and a dog. Drawing part damaged: the book dissolves into gray texture.
items.credit: Stable Diffusion XL (Stability AI), CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M

items.title: God becomes an ordinary man, then a crowd
items.caption: Damaging an open image AI turned its bearded, crowned God into a robed figure, then a man in headphones.
items.more: This is Stable Diffusion XL, not Meta’s Muse Image. Random noise in the part that reads the words (the words part) did that; noise in the part that paints dissolved him.
items.alt: Two rows of six pictures of God by Stable Diffusion XL, one seed. Words part damaged: a bearded, crowned face becomes a robed figure with a halo, a man with glasses and headphones, then a crowded comic scene. Drawing part damaged: the face dissolves into gray scribbles.
items.credit: Stable Diffusion XL (Stability AI), CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M

items.title: A rabbit’s shadow is just “Shadow”
items.caption: Meta’s open AI model named a rabbit from its drawing and outlines, but called its shadow “Shadow”.
items.more: Muse Glimmer named it from the drawing, the outline and the filled silhouette; “Shadow” was its most common wrong answer (10 times).
items.alt: Four versions of a rabbit: the line drawing, its outline, a black silhouette, and a soft gray shadow on a wall.
items.credit: Muse Image line drawings; outlines, silhouettes and shadows made by code; names by Muse Glimmer (Meta)

items.title: A hat becomes a bowler, then a UFO
items.caption: Meta’s open AI model called a hat’s silhouette a “bowler” and its shadow a “UFO”.
items.more: Muse Glimmer named the hat from its drawing and outline; seven shadows in all were called a “UFO”.
items.alt: Four versions of a hat: the line drawing, its outline, a black silhouette, and a soft gray oval shadow on a wall.
items.credit: Muse Image line drawings; outlines, silhouettes and shadows made by code; names by Muse Glimmer (Meta)

items.title: Twelve shadows on the cave wall
items.caption: Meta’s open AI model named 67 of 100 everyday objects from their shadows alone.
items.more: Muse Glimmer still named the scissors and the anchor here; the rabbit and the guitar became “Shadow”.
items.alt: Twelve dark shadows on a firelit cave wall, each with Muse Glimmer’s answer: rabbit “Shadow”, scissors correct, hat “UFO”, anchor correct, guitar “Shadow”, bicycle correct, glove “hand”, cat correct, igloo “Umbrella”, helicopter correct, bread “UFO”, umbrella correct.
items.credit: Muse Image line drawings; outlines, silhouettes and shadows made by code; names by Muse Glimmer (Meta)

items.title: What survives as a shadow?
items.caption: Meta’s open AI model named 100% of line drawings but 67% of soft shadows.
items.more: Muse Glimmer named 86% of the outlines and 90% of the filled silhouettes; the clock was lost in every reduced version.
items.alt: A grid of four objects (cat, scissors, bicycle, clock), each as a line drawing, an outline, a black silhouette and a gray cast shadow. The clock’s outline, silhouette and shadow are plain circles.
items.credit: Muse Image line drawings; outlines, silhouettes and shadows made by code; names by Muse Glimmer (Meta)

items.title: Asked for 16 chairs, Meta’s AI drew one
items.caption: Asked for a chair 16 times, Meta’s image AI drew one chair; 16 people drew 16.
items.more: Left: Muse Image, the same slatted chair from the same angle. Right: players of Google’s Quick, Draw! game. People’s chairs differ from one another nearly 3 times as much (spread 0.36 against 0.13).
items.alt: Two grids of 16 chair doodles. Left, by Meta’s Muse Image: nearly identical slat-back wooden chairs in three-quarter view. Right, by 16 people: simple side-view chairs, each drawn differently.
items.credit: Muse Image (Meta); people: Google Quick, Draw! (CC BY 4.0)

items.title: Stacked: one sharp chair, or a cloud
items.caption: Stacked, Meta’s image AI’s 16 chairs make one sharp chair, and people’s a cloud of lines.
items.more: Lay the 16 drawings on top of each other: Muse Image’s line up; people’s, from Google’s Quick, Draw! game, don’t.
items.alt: Muse Image’s 16 chairs and people’s 16 chairs slide from a grid onto one another: the AI’s stack into one dark, sharp chair, people’s into a gray cloud of lines.
items.credit: Muse Image (Meta); people: Google Quick, Draw! (CC BY 4.0)

items.title: The AI’s average clock reads 10:10
items.caption: Stacked, Meta’s image AI’s 16 clocks show crisp hands at ten past ten.
items.more: 13 of 16 read 10:10 by eye, the time in watch adverts; averaged pixel by pixel, people’s 200 clocks blur into a soft ring.
items.alt: Two pixel averages. Left, Muse Image’s 16 clock doodles: a crisp ring of ticks with two sharp hands at ten past ten. Right, 200 people’s clocks: a soft gray ring with a faint stroke up to the 12.
items.credit: Muse Image (Meta); people: Google Quick, Draw! (CC BY 4.0)

items.title: Ask for a time, and it draws it
items.caption: Asked for a time, Meta’s image AI drew it: none of its 72 clocks showed 10:10.
items.more: 10:10 is a habit, not a limit: 93% of those clocks got the minute hand right.
items.alt: Ten clock doodles by Muse Image, each labelled with the time asked, from 1:20 to 12:25. The hands point roughly to each asked time, never to ten past ten.
items.credit: Muse Image (Meta)

items.title: Plato’s table, drawn the same way 16 times
items.caption: Meta’s image AI drew Plato’s own example, a table, almost the same way 16 times.
items.more: Plato uses a table as an example of an ideal Form in Republic X; Muse Image’s tables are 61% less varied than people’s (0.39 of their variety).
items.alt: Two grids of 16 table doodles. Left, Muse Image: the same four-legged table in three-quarter view. Right, people: quick, varied line drawings of tables.
items.credit: Muse Image (Meta); people: Google Quick, Draw! (CC BY 4.0)

items.title: Plato’s bed, sixteen times over
items.caption: Meta’s image AI’s 16 beds, Plato’s other example, have about half the variety of people’s.
items.more: Plato’s three beds are in Republic X; 0.47 of people’s variety is right in the middle of the 36 things we tested.
items.alt: Two grids of 16 bed doodles. Left, Muse Image: near-identical beds with a headboard and pillows in three-quarter view. Right, people: varied quick drawings of beds.
items.credit: Muse Image (Meta); people: Google Quick, Draw! (CC BY 4.0)

items.title: Name kinds of chair, and the variety returns
items.caption: Asked for 16 named kinds of chair, Meta’s image AI varied as much as people.
items.more: Asked for “any kind of chair”, it still drew its textbook chair; the named kinds ran from a rocking chair to a throne.
items.alt: Sixteen doodles by Muse Image, one per named kind: rocking chair, armchair, folding chair, office chair, recliner, beanbag, highchair, wheelchair, dining chair, bar chair, lounge chair, wingback, cantilever chair, throne, Adirondack chair, gaming chair.
items.credit: Muse Spark and Muse Image (Meta)

items.title: Another image AI draws far more varied pictures
items.caption: Another image AI, Stable Diffusion XL (middle), drew far more varied pictures from the same request.
items.more: So the sameness is Meta’s Muse Image, not every image AI: Stable Diffusion XL varied more for 34 of 35 things, at about 2.4 times the spread.
items.alt: Three grids of nine chairs from the same prompt. Left, Muse Image: the same slatted chair. Middle, Stable Diffusion XL: armchairs, an office chair and framed, shaded scenes. Right, people: quick line drawings.
items.credit: Muse Image (Meta); Stable Diffusion XL (Stability AI), CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M; people: Google Quick, Draw! (CC BY 4.0)

items.title: Bouba is round, kiki is spiky
items.caption: Meta’s image AI drew all 12 “bouba”s as soft blobs and all 12 “kiki”s as stars, as people do.
items.more: Two made-up words; 72% of 917 people in 25 languages make the same match.
items.alt: Top: 12 shapes Muse Image drew for “bouba”, soft rounded blobs. Bottom: 12 shapes it drew for “kiki”, spiky stars.
items.credit: Muse Image (Meta); people: Ćwiek et al. 2022 (published figures only)

items.title: A spiky-sounding made-up word comes out round
items.caption: “Keti” sounds spiky like “kiki”, yet Meta’s image AI drew 12 round blobs.
items.more: All eight new made-up words came out rounded: it learned the famous words, not what their sounds suggest.
items.alt: Top: 12 spiky stars Muse Image drew for “kiki”. Bottom: 12 rounded blobs it drew for the made-up word “keti”.
items.credit: Muse Image (Meta)

items.title: A shape with no name is spiky
items.caption: Asked for just “a shape”, Meta’s image AI drew stars and polygons.
items.more: Give it any made-up name except “kiki” or “takete” and it became a soft blob.
items.alt: Twelve shapes Muse Image drew for “a shape”: five-pointed stars, pentagons and hexagons.
items.credit: Muse Image (Meta)

items.title: Name a game: chess. Draw one: Super Mario
items.caption: Meta’s chat AI named chess 49 times in 50, but its image AI drew a Super Mario-style game.
items.more: Asked to name a game, Muse Spark said chess; asked to draw one, Muse Image drew a Super Mario-style platformer 9 times in 12.
items.alt: Twelve doodles by Muse Image for “a game”: mostly platform-game scenes, a little runner jumping over gaps and up steps towards a flag, and a winding maze.
items.credit: Muse Spark and Muse Image (Meta)

items.title: Name a bird: sparrow, 49 times in 50
items.caption: Asked for a bird, Meta’s chat AI said “sparrow” 49 times in 50; 20 people named 11 birds.
items.more: Muse Image, Meta’s image AI, drew the same little songbird 12 times.
items.alt: Twelve bird doodles by Muse Image, all the same small songbird in side view.
items.credit: Muse Spark and Muse Image (Meta); people: Banks & Connell (2023), CC BY 4.0

items.title: A tiny AI learns to draw a chair
items.caption: A small AI we trained on people’s chairs went from scribbles to chairs.
items.more: Trained from scratch on 20,000 chairs, it went from 18% recognizable to 87%, ending less varied than its data in all 8 runs.
items.alt: Seven training stages of a small sketch model (one of its 8 runs), its first four drawings at each: dots and stray lines at step 0, then angular strokes, then simple side-view chairs by step 25,600.
items.credit: A small sketch model trained on Google Quick, Draw! chairs (CC BY 4.0)

items.title: Stable Diffusion has no public childhood
items.caption: Even the earliest public stage of Stable Diffusion, an image AI, draws like a 10-year-old.
items.more: Five public training stages, the same random starting point; its first public snapshot already draws as recognizably as a 10-year-old, so there is no childhood to watch.
items.alt: The same chair prompt and seed at Stable Diffusion v1.1 to v1.5: a bentwood chair with a round seat each time, with small changes to the back.
items.credit: Stable Diffusion v1.1–v1.5, CreativeML OpenRAIL-M

items.title: The life of a chair, without children’s drawings
items.caption: An AI recognized 53% of chairs drawn at age 2, 89% at 10 and 92% by adults.
items.more: Each tile counts how many of 10 chair drawings it recognized; no child’s drawing is shown, only the counts.
items.alt: Icon arrays of 10 chairs, coloured for how many drawings are recognized as chairs: 5 at age 2, 8 at age 6, 9 at age 10 and 9 for adults; then Muse Image’s chair.
items.credit: children’s group statistics only (Long et al. 2024), no drawings shown; Muse Image (Meta)
